تبتعثون (form VIII)
# تَبْتَعِثُونَ (tabtaʕiṯūna) /tab.ta.ʕi.θuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# تُبْتَعَثُونَ (tubtaʕaṯūna) /tub.ta.ʕa.θuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
